articles.title: An Abandoned Family Dollar Became a Free Store — With a Roller Rink Inside
articles.summary: In New Orleans' Lower Ninth Ward, a graffiti-covered former Family Dollar is now the New Orleans Free Store. Everything is free, and twice a week the smooth floor becomes a roller rink.

articles.title: US and Denmark Reach Greenland Security Deal After Trump's Threats
articles.summary: The US and Denmark announced a deal on Greenland's security after Trump threatened to seize the territory. Nato welcomed it, but no text has been released. It's expected to be signed next week.

articles.title: Congo Launches Ebola Vaccinations for Front-Line Workers in Bunia
articles.summary: Congo began vaccinating health workers against Ebola in Bunia, the epicenter of the fastest-growing outbreak ever. The Bundibugyo virus has no licensed vaccine, so an existing shot is being tested.
